title: HHHusher reveal (v2)
description: The site's scroll reveals in CSS: headings whose lines rise and fade in one after another as they come up the window (each word rides its own view timeline, so a line moves together), plus fade, rise and parallax-drift classes for anything else.
notes: CSS scroll-driven animations: browsers without them, and reduced motion, show everything in place
put drift on a picture inside an overflow-clip frame (not overflow-hidden, which freezes the timeline)
